Dimensions: Sheet: 1 3/8 x 1 3/4 in. (3.5 x 4.4 cm) (fragment cut from the upper portion of "Sketches on the Coast Survey Plate")
Title: Two Female Heads and Standing Figure (from Sketches on the Coast Survey Plate)
Medium: Etching; proof impression of the only state (Glasgow 1); this is an irregular fragment cut from the upper portion of "Sketches on the Coast Survey Plate" (Kennedy no. 1) by Whistler and mounted on a board with six other related fragments. Cited by Glasgow as the earliest known impression.
Repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
Credit Line: Gift of Margaret C. Buell, Helen L. King, and Sybil A. Walk, 1970
